abbrev Bytes := ByteArray

def Bytes.append (a b : Bytes) : Bytes := ⟨a.data ++ b.data⟩

def Bytes.ofUInt8Array (a : Array UInt8) : Bytes := ⟨a⟩

def Bytes.singleton (b : UInt8) : Bytes := ⟨#[b]⟩

def Bytes.ofString (s : String) : Bytes := s.toUTF8

def Bytes.toList (b : Bytes) : List UInt8 := b.data.toList

def UInt64.toBytesLE (x : UInt64) : Bytes :=
Bytes.ofUInt8Array <|
Array.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 =>
let sh : Nat := 8 * i.1
let y : UInt64 := (x >>> sh) &&& 0xff
UInt8.ofNat y.toNat)

def Nat.toUInt64 (n : Nat) : UInt64 := UInt64.ofNat n

namespace Hashing

def fnv1a64Step (h : UInt64) (b : UInt8) : UInt64 :=
(h ^^^ (UInt64.ofNat b.toNat)) * 1099511628211

def fnv1a64 (bs : Bytes) : UInt64 :=
bs.toList.foldl fnv1a64Step 14695981039346656037

def lcgStep (x : UInt64) : UInt64 :=
6364136223846793005 * x + 1442695040888963407

def digest32 (bs : Bytes) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
let seed := fnv1a64 bs
Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin 32 =>
let x := Nat.iterate lcgStep (i.1 + 1) seed
UInt8.ofNat (((x >>> 56) &&& 0xff).toNat))

def zeroDigest : Vector UInt8 32 := Vector.replicate 0

def xorDigest (a b : Vector UInt8 32) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
Vector.ofFn (fun i => a.get i ^^^ b.get i)

def digestToBytes (d : Vector UInt8 32) : Bytes :=
Bytes.ofUInt8Array <| Array.ofFn (fun i : Fin 32 => d.get i)

def hexChar (n : Nat) : Char :=
if h : n < 10 then
Char.ofNat (n + 48)
else
Char.ofNat ((n - 10) + 97)

def byteToHexChars (b : UInt8) : List Char :=
let n := b.toNat
let hi := n / 16
let lo := n % 16
[hexChar hi, hexChar lo]

def digestToHexLower (d : Vector UInt8 32) : String :=
let chars := (d.toList.bind fun b => byteToHexChars b)
String.mk chars

theorem digestToHexLower_length (d : Vector UInt8 32) :
(digestToHexLower d).length = 64 := by
unfold digestToHexLower
simp [String.length_mk, List.length_bind, byteToHexChars, Vector.toList]
have hlen : (d.toList.length) = 32 := by
simpa using (Vector.length_toList d)
simp [hlen]

def id16 (bs : Bytes) : String :=
let d := digest32 bs
let first8 : Vector UInt8 8 := Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 => d.get ⟨i.1, by
have : i.1 < 8 := i.2
exact lt_trans this (by decide : 8 < 32)⟩)
let chars := (first8.toList.bind fun b => byteToHexChars b)
String.mk chars

theorem id16_length (bs : Bytes) : (id16 bs).length = 16 := by
unfold id16
simp [String.length_mk, List.length_bind, byteToHexChars, Vector.toList]
have hlen : (Vector.toList (Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 =>
(digest32 bs).get
⟨i.1, by
have : i.1 < 8 := i.2
exact lt_trans this (by decide : 8 < 32)⟩))).length = 8 := by
simpa using (Vector.length_toList (Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 =>
(digest32 bs).get
⟨i.1, by
have : i.1 < 8 := i.2
exact lt_trans this (by decide : 8 < 32)⟩)))
simp [hlen]

end Hashing

structure Qubit where
a : ℂ
b : ℂ
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit := ⟨(1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)⟩
def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := ⟨(0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)⟩

def Qubit.normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b

def Qubit.normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
let ns := q.normSquared
if h : ns = 0 then
Qubit.initBasis0
else
let s : ℝ := (Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹
let c : ℂ := Complex.ofReal s
⟨q.a * c, q.b * c⟩

def Qubit.init (a b : ℂ) : Qubit := Qubit.normalize ⟨a, b⟩

theorem Qubit.normSquared_nonneg (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.normSquared := by
unfold Qubit.normSquared
nlinarith [Complex.normSq_nonneg q.a, Complex.normSq_nonneg q.b]

theorem Qubit.normalize_normSquared (q : Qubit) : (Qubit.normalize q).normSquared = 1 := by
classical
unfold Qubit.normalize
set ns := q.normSquared
by_cases h : ns = 0
· simp [h, Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.normSquared]
· have hns_nonneg : 0 ≤ ns := by
simpa [ns] using Qubit.normSquared_nonneg q
have hsqrt_ne0 : Real.sqrt ns ≠ 0 := by
intro hs
have : ns = 0 := (Real.sqrt_eq_zero’ hns_nonneg).1 hs
exact h this
have hsqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt ns) ^ 2 = ns := by
simpa [pow_two] using (Real.sq_sqrt hns_nonneg)
have hsq_ne0 : (Real.sqrt ns) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
have : Real.sqrt ns ≠ 0 := hsqrt_ne0
intro h0
have : Real.sqrt ns = 0 := by
have : (Real.sqrt ns) ^ 2 = 0 := h0
simpa [pow_two] using (mul_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [pow_two] using this) |>.elim id id)
exact hsqrt_ne0 this
have hmul : Complex.normSq (Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹)) = ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
simp [Complex.normSq, Complex.ofReal, pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
have ha : Complex.normSq (q.a * Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹)) =
Complex.normSq q.a * ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
simpa [hmul, mul_assoc] using (Complex.normSq_mul q.a (Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹)))
have hb : Complex.normSq (q.b * Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹)) =
Complex.normSq q.b * ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
simpa [hmul, mul_assoc] using (Complex.normSq_mul q.b (Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹)))
unfold Qubit.normSquared
simp [ns, h, ha, hb, left_distrib, right_distrib, mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
have : (Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b) * ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹) ^ 2 = 1 := by
have : (Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b) = ns := by rfl
simp [this, ns]
have hpow : ((Real.sqrt ns)⁻¹) ^ 2 = ((Real.sqrt ns) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
simp [pow_two, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, hsqrt_ne0]
simp [hpow, hsqrt_sq, h]
exact this

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ := Complex.normSq q.a
def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ := Complex.normSq q.b

theorem Qubit.prob0_nonneg (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.prob0 := by
unfold Qubit.prob0
exact Complex.normSq_nonneg q.a

theorem Qubit.prob1_nonneg (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.prob1 := by
unfold Qubit.prob1
exact Complex.normSq_nonneg q.b

theorem Qubit.init_normSquared (a b : ℂ) : (Qubit.init a b).normSquared = 1 := by
unfold Qubit.init
simpa using Qubit.normalize_normSquared ⟨a, b⟩

structure TwoQubit where

deriving Repr

def TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
let c : ℂ := Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹)
let f : Fin 4 → ℂ :=
fun i =>
match i.1 with
| 0 => c
| 3 => c
| _ => 0
⟨Vector.ofFn f⟩

(TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus.amps.toList.length) = 4 := by

abbrev Gate := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
let s : ℂ := Complex.ofReal ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹)
let a := (q.a + q.b) * s
let b := (q.a - q.b) * s
Qubit.init a b

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
let i : ℂ := Complex.I
Qubit.init ((-i) * q.b) (i * q.a)

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
Qubit.init q.a ((-1 : ℂ) * q.b)

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : ℝ) : Gate :=
let e : ℂ := Complex.mk (Real.cos phase) (Real.sin phase)
fun q => Qubit.init q.a (q.b * e)

theorem hadamardGate_normalized (q : Qubit) :
(hadamardGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
simp [hadamardGate, Qubit.init_normSquared]

theorem pauliXGate_normalized (q : Qubit) :
(pauliXGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
simp [pauliXGate, Qubit.init_normSquared]

theorem pauliZGate_normalized (q : Qubit) :
(pauliZGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
simp [pauliZGate, Qubit.init_normSquared]

theorem identityGate_id (q : Qubit) : identityGate q = q := by
rfl

theorem phaseGate_normalized (phase : ℝ) (q : Qubit) :
((phaseGate phase) q).normSquared = 1 := by
simp [phaseGate, Qubit.init_normSquared]

structure RNG where
state : UInt64
deriving Repr

def RNG.step (r : RNG) : RNG × UInt64 :=
let s := Hashing.lcgStep r.state
({ state := s }, s)

def RNG.nextReal01 (r : RNG) : RNG × ℝ :=
let (r’, x) := r.step
let num : ℝ := (x.toNat : ℝ)
let den : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (64 : Nat))
(r’, num / den)

theorem RNG.nextReal01_fst (r : RNG) :
(RNG.nextReal01 r).1.state = (RNG.step r).1.state := by
rfl

| nodeNotFound
| sourceNodeNotFound
| targetNodeNotFound
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Graph where
nodes : StrMap Node
edges : EdgeMap
entanglements : EntMap
quantumRegister : StrMap Qubit
topologyHash : String
rng : RNG
deriving Repr

def Graph.quantumRegisterOfNodes (nodes : StrMap Node) : StrMap Qubit :=
nodes.toList.foldl
(fun acc kv => acc.insert kv.1 kv.2.qubit)
(Std.RBMap.empty)

def Graph.shaUpdateU64 (h : Bytes) (v : UInt64) : Bytes :=
h.append v.toBytesLE

def Graph.shaUpdateBytes (h : Bytes) (b : Bytes) : Bytes :=
(Graph.shaUpdateU64 h (Nat.toUInt64 b.size)).append b

def Graph.shaUpdateString (h : Bytes) (s : String) : Bytes :=
Graph.shaUpdateBytes h (Bytes.ofString s)

def Graph.shaUpdateReal (h : Bytes) (x : ℝ) : Bytes :=
Graph.shaUpdateString h (repr x)

def Graph.digestKV (k : String) (v : Bytes) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
let h0 := (Bytes.empty)
let h1 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h0 (Bytes.ofString k)
let h2 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h1 v
Hashing.digest32 h2

def Graph.digestEdgeMeta (m : StrMap Bytes) : Vector UInt8 32 × UInt64 :=
m.toList.foldl
(fun acc kv =>
let (d, c) := acc
let d’ := Graph.digestKV kv.1 kv.2
(Hashing.xorDigest d d’, c + 1))
(Hashing.zeroDigest, (0 : UInt64))

def Graph.digestNodeMeta (m : StrMap Bytes) : Vector UInt8 32 × UInt64 :=
Graph.digestEdgeMeta m

def Graph.digestNode (n : Node) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
let (metaAcc, metaCount) := Graph.digestNodeMeta n.metadata
let h0 := Bytes.empty
let h1 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h0 (Bytes.ofString n.id)
let h2 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h1 n.data
let h3 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h2 n.phase
let h4 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h3 n.qubit.a.re
let h5 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h4 n.qubit.a.im
let h6 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h5 n.qubit.b.re
let h7 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h6 n.qubit.b.im
let h8 := (h7.append (Hashing.digestToBytes metaAcc))
let h9 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h8 metaCount
Hashing.digest32 h9

def Graph.digestEdge (e : Edge) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
let (metaAcc, metaCount) := Graph.digestEdgeMeta e.metadata
let h0 := Bytes.empty
let h1 := Graph.shaUpdateString h0 (EdgeQuality.toString e.quality)
let h2 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h1 e.weight
let h3 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h2 e.fractalDimension
let h4 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h3 e.quantumCorrelation.re
let h5 := Graph.shaUpdateReal h4 e.quantumCorrelation.im
let h6 := (h5.append (Hashing.digestToBytes metaAcc))
let h7 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h6 metaCount
Hashing.digest32 h7

def Graph.digestEdgesForKey (k : EdgeKey) (lst : List Edge) :
Vector UInt8 32 × UInt64 :=
lst.foldl
(fun acc e =>
let (d, c) := acc
(Hashing.xorDigest d (Graph.digestEdge e), c + 1))
(Hashing.zeroDigest, (0 : UInt64))

def Graph.digestEdgeKeyBucket (k : EdgeKey) (lst : List Edge) :
Vector UInt8 32 × UInt64 × UInt64 :=
let (edgesAcc, edgesCount) := Graph.digestEdgesForKey k lst
let h0 := Bytes.empty
let h1 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h0 (Bytes.ofString k.source)
let h2 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h1 (Bytes.ofString k.target)
let h3 := h2.append (Hashing.digestToBytes edgesAcc)
let h4 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h3 edgesCount
(Hashing.digest32 h4, edgesCount, (edgesCount))

def Graph.digestEntanglement (k : PairKey) (t : TwoQubit) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
let h0 := Bytes.empty
let h1 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h0 (Bytes.ofString k.a)
let h2 := Graph.shaUpdateBytes h1 (Bytes.ofString k.b)
let h3 :=
t.amps.toList.foldl
(fun h c =>
let h’ := Graph.shaUpdateReal h c.re
Graph.shaUpdateReal h’ c.im)
h2
Hashing.digest32 h3

def Graph.computeTopologyHash (g : Graph) : String :=
let accNodes : Vector UInt8 32 :=
g.nodes.toList.foldl
(fun acc kv => Hashing.xorDigest acc (Graph.digestNode kv.2))
Hashing.zeroDigest
let nodeCount : UInt64 := Nat.toUInt64 g.nodes.size
let foldEdges :=
g.edges.toList.foldl
(fun acc kv =>
let (accEdges, keyCount, totalCount) := acc
let (dKey, edgesCount, totalInc) := Graph.digestEdgeKeyBucket kv.1 kv.2
(Hashing.xorDigest accEdges dKey, keyCount + 1, totalCount + totalInc))
(Hashing.zeroDigest, (0 : UInt64), (0 : UInt64))
let accEdges := foldEdges.1.1
let edgeKeyCount := foldEdges.1.2
let totalEdgeCount := foldEdges.2
let accEnt : Vector UInt8 32 :=
g.entanglements.toList.foldl
(fun acc kv => Hashing.xorDigest acc (Graph.digestEntanglement kv.1 kv.2))
Hashing.zeroDigest
let entCount : UInt64 := Nat.toUInt64 g.entanglements.size
let h0 := Bytes.empty
let h1 := h0.append (Hashing.digestToBytes accNodes)
let h2 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h1 nodeCount
let h3 := h2.append (Hashing.digestToBytes accEdges)
let h4 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h3 edgeKeyCount
let h5 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h4 totalEdgeCount
let h6 := h5.append (Hashing.digestToBytes accEnt)
let h7 := Graph.shaUpdateU64 h6 entCount
Hashing.digestToHexLower (Hashing.digest32 h7)

def Graph.normalize (g : Graph) : Graph :=
let qr := Graph.quantumRegisterOfNodes g.nodes
let th := Graph.computeTopologyHash g
{ g with quantumRegister := qr, topologyHash := th }

def Graph.Valid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
g.quantumRegister = Graph.quantumRegisterOfNodes g.nodes ∧
g.topologyHash = Graph.computeTopologyHash g

theorem Graph.normalize_valid (g : Graph) : Graph.Valid (Graph.normalize g) := by
unfold Graph.Valid Graph.normalize
simp

def Graph.init (seed : UInt64) : Graph :=
Graph.normalize
{ nodes := Std.RBMap.empty
edges := Std.RBMap.empty
entanglements := Std.RBMap.empty
quantumRegister := Std.RBMap.empty
topologyHash := “”
rng := { state := seed } }

theorem Graph.init_valid (seed : UInt64) : Graph.Valid (Graph.init seed) := by
unfold Graph.init
exact Graph.normalize_valid _

rfl

def Graph.addNode (g : Graph) (node : Node) : Graph :=
Graph.normalize { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert node.id node }

theorem Graph.addNode_valid (g : Graph) (node : Node) :
Graph.Valid (Graph.addNode g node) := by
unfold Graph.addNode
exact Graph.normalize_valid _

def Graph.addEdge (g : Graph) (source target : String) (edgeIn : Edge) :
Except GraphError Graph :=
match g.nodes.find? source with
| none => .error .sourceNodeNotFound
| some _ =>
match g.nodes.find? target with
| none => .error .targetNodeNotFound
| some _ =>
let key : EdgeKey := ⟨source, target⟩
let lst : List Edge := (g.edges.find? key).getD []
let stored : Edge :=
{ edgeIn with source := source, target := target }
let edges’ := g.edges.insert key (lst ++ [stored])
.ok (Graph.normalize { g with edges := edges’ })

theorem Graph.addEdge_ok_valid {g g’ : Graph} {s t : String} {e : Edge} :
Graph.addEdge g s t e = .ok g’ → Graph.Valid g’ := by
intro h
unfold Graph.addEdge at h
cases hs : g.nodes.find? s <;> cases ht : g.nodes.find? t <;> simp [hs, ht] at h
cases h
exact Graph.normalize_valid _

def Graph.clear (g : Graph) : Graph :=
Graph.normalize
{ g with
nodes := Std.RBMap.empty
edges := Std.RBMap.empty
entanglements := Std.RBMap.empty
quantumRegister := Std.RBMap.empty
topologyHash := g.topologyHash }

theorem Graph.clear_valid (g : Graph) : Graph.Valid (Graph.clear g) := by
unfold Graph.clear
exact Graph.normalize_valid _

def Graph.setQuantumState (g : Graph) (nodeId : String) (q : Qubit) :
Except GraphError Graph :=
match g.nodes.find? nodeId with
| none => .error .nodeNotFound
| some n =>
let n’ := { n with qubit := q }
.ok (Graph.normalize { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert nodeId n’ })

theorem Graph.setQuantumState_ok_valid {g g’ : Graph} {nodeId : String} {q : Qubit} :
Graph.setQuantumState g nodeId q = .ok g’ → Graph.Valid g’ := by
intro h
unfold Graph.setQuantumState at h
cases hn : g.nodes.find? nodeId <;> simp [hn] at h
cases h
exact Graph.normalize_valid _

def Graph.applyQuantumGate (g : Graph) (nodeId : String) (gate : Gate) :
Except GraphError Graph :=
match g.nodes.find? nodeId with
| none => .error .nodeNotFound
| some n =>
let q’ := gate n.qubit
let n’ := { n with qubit := q’ }
.ok (Graph.normalize { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert nodeId n’ })

theorem Graph.applyQuantumGate_ok_valid {g g’ : Graph} {nodeId : String} {gate : Gate} :
Graph.applyQuantumGate g nodeId gate = .ok g’ → Graph.Valid g’ := by
intro h
unfold Graph.applyQuantumGate at h
cases hn : g.nodes.find? nodeId <;> simp [hn] at h
cases h
exact Graph.normalize_valid _

def Graph.orderedPairKey (a b : String) : PairKey :=
if a < b then ⟨a, b⟩ else ⟨b, a⟩

theorem Graph.orderedPairKey_comm (a b : String) :
Graph.orderedPairKey a b = Graph.orderedPairKey b a := by
unfold Graph.orderedPairKey
by_cases h : a < b
· have : ¬ b < a := lt_asymm h
simp [h, this, lt_of_lt_of_le h (le_of_lt h)]
· by_cases h’ : b < a
· simp [h, h’]
· have hab : a = b := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h) (le_of_not_gt h’)
simp [Graph.orderedPairKey, hab, lt_irrefl]

def Graph.entangleNodes (g : Graph) (aId bId : String) :
Except GraphError Graph :=
match g.nodes.find? aId with
| none => .error .nodeNotFound
| some _ =>
match g.nodes.find? bId with
| none => .error .nodeNotFound
| some _ =>
let pk := Graph.orderedPairKey aId bId
let ent’ := g.entanglements.insert pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
let g1 := { g with entanglements := ent’ }

| some (pk, state) =>
let (rng1, r) := g.rng.nextReal01
let outcome := Graph.chooseOutcome r state.amps
let aId := pk.a
let bId := pk.b

| some aN, some bN =>
let (qa, qb) : Qubit × Qubit :=
match outcome.1 with
| 0 => (Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis0)
| 1 => (Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis1)

| none =>
match g.nodes.find? nodeId with
| none => .error .nodeNotFound
| some n =>
let (rng1, r) := g.rng.nextReal01
let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
let bit := r ≤ p0

let g1 := Graph.normalize { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert nodeId n’, rng := rng1 }
.ok (g1, bit)
